summary: OAuth activation wiring meets the requested route, callback, VPN-only ingress, controller-only secret, and exact remote-key contract. Stale committed render tests still fail against the former disabled defaults.
validation: Diff is limited to the two scoped Youtarr files; no secrets, unrelated files, or graphify files.
Rendered output verifies youtarr.arr.rickebo.com, exact callback, TLS/allowlist, youtarr-public port 8082, no public Ingress, and no ExternalDNS.
ExternalSecret remote keys are exactly the three youtarr-google-oauth-* names; OAuth secret refs occur only on the controller.
Focused OAuth tests and Helm checks pass; committed related render tests fail on old default and ExternalSecret-count assertions.
blockers: test_internal_ingress_render.py:test_public_oauth_route_and_google_secret_remain_disabled_by_default expects OAuth resources absent, contradicting enabled defaults.
test_internal_ingress_render.py:test_admin_and_public_policies_keep_traefik_scoped_to_8082 expects no policy; test_render.py expects four ExternalSecrets instead of five.
next_action: Update stale render assertions while retaining explicit disabled-mode coverage, then rerun the complete Youtarr test suite.

issues.title: Stale render tests reject activated OAuth defaults
issues.details: The feature wiring renders as requested, but committed render tests fail against the old gated-disabled contract. Update those assertions and preserve explicit controller.public.enabled=false coverage.
